block.simplyspeakers.speaker: Speaker
item.simplyspeakers.speaker: Speaker
gui.simplyspeakers.speaker.title: Speaker
gui.simplyspeakers.proxy_speaker.title: Proxy Speaker
gui.simplyspeakers.speaker_id.tooltip: A unique name for this speaker. Proxy speakers with the same ID will play the same audio.
gui.simplyspeakers.proxy_speaker_id.tool: Match a main Speaker's non-empty ID. Both speakers must be redstone-powered.
gui.simplyspeakers.search.tooltip: Search for music files by name
gui.simplyspeakers.upload.invalid_type: Invalid file type. Only MP3 and WAV files are supported.
gui.simplyspeakers.max_volume.tooltip: The overall volume level. Higher = louder at all distances.
gui.simplyspeakers.proxy_max_volume.tool: The overall volume level. Higher = louder at all distances.
gui.simplyspeakers.max_range.tooltip: How far away the audio can be heard (in blocks).
gui.simplyspeakers.proxy_max_range.toolt: How far away the audio can be heard from this proxy (in blocks).
gui.simplyspeakers.audio_dropoff.tooltip: How fast volume fades with distance. 0% = full volume until max range, 100% = gradual fade.
gui.simplyspeakers.loop.tooltip: When ON, the audio will restart automatically when it ends.
gui.simplyspeakers.proxy.helper: This proxy follows the linked speaker's selected audio. Set a matching Speaker ID to link them.
gui.simplyspeakers.delete_confirm.title: Delete audio?
gui.simplyspeakers.delete_confirm.body: "%s" will be removed from the server.
gui.simplyspeakers.transport.title: Transport
gui.simplyspeakers.transport.seek.toolti: Seek jumps to an absolute position in the track. The server is authoritative.
gui.simplyspeakers.playlist.title: Playlist
gui.simplyspeakers.playlist.empty: No tracks queued. Select audio and press 'Add selected'.
gui.simplyspeakers.playlist.no_selection: Select a track in the audio list first.
gui.simplyspeakers.playlist.shuffle.tool: Plays playlist entries in a random order.
gui.simplyspeakers.network_name.tooltip: Human-friendly name shown in /simplyspeakers network listings.
gui.simplyspeakers.redstone.tooltip: power: on=play/off=stop; pulse: edge=restart; toggle: edge=play/pause; next: edge=next track; analog_volume: signal 1-15 = volume; analog_track: edge selects playlist slot by signal.
gui.simplyspeakers.access.tooltip: Who may control this speaker. public/trusted/owner_only/operators. Owners are claimed on first policy change.
gui.simplyspeakers.directionality.toolti: 0% = omnidirectional. Higher values focus audio into the cone in front of the speaker.
gui.simplyspeakers.cone_angle.tooltip: Full angle of the unattenuated cone in front of the speaker.
gui.simplyspeakers.rear_attenuation.tool: How much quieter audio is directly behind the speaker.
commands.help.simplyspeakers: /simplyspeakers (alias /ss): networks, network <name> info|play|..., speaker <pos>, audio list
